The claim incorrectly states that the eligibility for electrocution in Kentucky is based on the date the capital crime was *committed*. According to Kentucky Revised Statutes § 431.220, the March 31, 1998 cutoff is explicitly tied to the date the death sentence was *received* (sentenced), not the date of the offense. Because the claim misstates a material condition of the statute, it is refuted.
